edges.reason: Constructor writes msg.sender into the owner state variable, making ownership caller-defined.
Delayed transferOwnership writes the newOwner parameter into the owner state variable.
onlyOwner compares the untrusted msg.sender against the stored owner.
owner state variable is read by the onlyOwner check.
onlyOwner modifier gates execution of transferOwnership.
block.timestamp is stored into lastExecuted when an operation is scheduled.
block.timestamp drives the wall-clock comparison that releases delayed execution.
requiredDelay state variable is cached into the reqDelay local.
reqDelay controls the delay branch inside delayedExecution.
operationHash is the mapping key used to read and clear lastExecuted.
delayedExecution modifier body is invoked on transferOwnership, deferring the write.
newDelay parameter is written into requiredDelay.
serviceNameHash parameter keys the namedService mapping write.
serviceAddress parameter is stored into the namedService mapping.
getRegisteredService resolves service names from the namedService mapping that other contracts trust.
AutomationBot.execute requires msg.sender to be the registered AUTOMATION_EXECUTOR.
cdpId parameter flows into trigger validation and vault operations.
triggerId parameter selects the activeTriggers record to validate and clear.
execute performs an external call to the command contract while vault permissions are still granted.
commandAddress local determines the callee of the external command execution.
Calldata executionData is forwarded verbatim to the external command call.
execute validates trigger existence before drawing debt or calling the command.
Stored trigger hash is compared against the recomputed hash.
execute calls drawDaiFromVault before invoking the external command.
daiCoverage parameter determines how much dai is drawn from the vault.
drawDaiFromVault grants and then revokes manager permissions around the external drawDebt call.
Execution flow enters McdUtils.drawDebt, which performs manager frob/move and vat exit calls.
msg.sender is forwarded as the sendTo recipient of the drawn dai.
addRecord requires the caller to be allowed on the cdp before registering a trigger.
msg.sender is passed as the operator checked by isCdpAllowed.
addRecord writes a new TriggerRecord into activeTriggers.
triggersCounter is incremented and used as the new trigger id.
addTrigger performs an external call to AutomationBot.addRecord.
addTrigger grants cdpAllow to the automation bot via the manager.
removeRecord zeroes the TriggerRecord stored in activeTriggers.
removeTrigger performs an external call to AutomationBot.removeRecord.
removeTrigger may revoke cdpAllow permissions on the manager.
changeApprovalStatus toggles the bot's cdpAllow permission on the manager.
swap performs low-level token calls on an arbitrary asset address through SafeERC20.
fromToken local is used for balance and allowance reads during the swap.
AutomationExecutor.execute requires the caller to be an authorized caller.
callers mapping is read to authorize the caller of execute.
Executor calls bot.execute externally, allowing nested callbacks before the refund is paid.
execute transfers the miner bribe to block.coinbase.
minerBribe parameter determines the value sent to block.coinbase.
execute refunds the computed gas cost to msg.sender.
initialGasAvailable participates in unchecked arithmetic for the gas refund.
finalGasAvailable participates in unchecked arithmetic for the gas refund.
gasRefund is subtracted from consumed gas and can underflow/overflow the cast.
Computed etherUsed is the amount transferred to the caller.
msg.sender is the recipient of the gas refund transfer.
withdraw performs a low-level call to the owner after a balance check.
withdraw is protected by onlyOwner against msg.sender.
asset parameter selects between native ETH and ERC20 withdrawal.
getNextPrice requires msg.sender to be whitelisted before reading the oracle.
whitelisted mapping is read to authorize the oracle price read.
CloseCommand.execute delegatecalls arbitrary user-supplied executionData to the MPA address.
Decoded selector prefix is compared against the expected MPA selector.
collRatio is read and compared against the stop-loss threshold.
isExecutionLegal performs an external call to McdView.getRatio.
Rate from the jug is used as divisor in the dart calculation.
dart result passes through toInt256 which enforces a non-negative int256 bound.
borrowedDai parameter is the amount requested from the vault.
sendTo parameter is the recipient of the exited dai.
urn local is used for vat dai balance and debt computations.
vat local is used for permission checks and dai exit.
manager local resolved from the registry is used for all cdp operations in execute.
initialDelay parameter is validated and stored as requiredDelay.
triggerData parameter is hashed to validate the stored trigger record.
vaultId parameter selects the urn and ilk read from the manager.
useNextPrice flag chooses between current and next oracle price.
ilk parameter selects the collateral type when reading vat data.
otherAsset parameter determines the token direction of the swap.
amount parameter is validated against the executor balance before swapping.
DummyCommand.execute branches on the revertsInExecute flag; self reference marks the conditional path.

normalization_plan.reason: cdpId is a plain input consumed only by AutomationBot.execute and its trigger validation.
triggerId indexes activeTriggers only within AutomationBot.execute.
executionData is forwarded verbatim into the external command call.
triggerData is hashed solely to validate the stored trigger record.
daiCoverage is passed directly to drawDaiFromVault as the debt amount.
newOwner exists only to be written to owner by transferOwnership.
newDelay exists only to update the requiredDelay state variable.
serviceNameHash is the key used when writing the namedService mapping.
serviceAddress is the value written into the namedService mapping.
borrowedDai defines the dai amount drawn inside McdUtils.drawDebt.
sendTo is the exit recipient within McdUtils.drawDebt.
minerBribe is only used as the value of the block.coinbase transfer.
gasRefund adjusts the gas accounting inside AutomationExecutor.execute.
otherAsset selects the token direction in the swap routine.
amount is validated and forwarded to the exchange inside swap.
asset decides between the native low-level call and an ERC20 transfer.
vaultId is used only to resolve urn and ilk within getVaultInfo.
useNextPrice only selects the price source inside getRatio.
ilk is a collateral identifier consumed by the price and ratio helpers.
initialDelay is validated and stored as requiredDelay at deployment.
operationHash is a scratch value that keys lastExecuted inside the modifier.
reqDelay is a cached copy of requiredDelay used only in the modifier.
manager local is a temporary cast of the registry lookup inside execute.
commandAddress is the target address of the external command call.
urn is a temporary value used only inside drawDebt.
vat is a temporary value used only inside drawDebt.
dart is the intermediate debt delta computed by _getDrawDart.
initialGasAvailable is a gas snapshot scoped to the execute routine.
finalGasAvailable is a gas snapshot scoped to the execute routine.
etherUsed is the value transferred to the caller as a gas refund.
collRatio is a local used only for the stop-loss comparison.
prefix is a decoded local compared against the expected selector.
expectedSelector is a local derived from triggerType inside execute.
fromToken is a temporary token reference used only inside swap.
triggersHash is a local read from activeTriggers for comparison.
rate is a temporary stability fee value used only in the dart computation.
